result.process_summary: Both processes involve searching a vast, undifferentiated substrate (sand or data) for hidden valuable items (treasures or patterns). The seeker uses specialized tools (metal detector, sifter, map vs. machine learning, statistics, databases) to locate, separate, and guide attention to these items, ultimately extracting and interpreting them as useful discoveries.
